Quick internal note — I dug into the last 30 days of traces. Two things to flag before the call:
- We see a 3.1% uptick in p95 token latency for chat workloads starting 2028-05-18; correlated with a config change on the customer-facing endpoint (increased max_seq). We can show sample traces.
- KV cache hit-rate for the main chat route is ~62% (below the target 75%). That’s the biggest immediate win: improving prefix caching would drop token counts and latency.

I’ll attach a short ops pack with latency graphs and sample traces for the call. If the customer is open, we should propose a short pilot using our cache-hot path + slightly higher batching to prove a 20–30% token cost reduction.

-Rishi

Subject: Re: VerdantRun renewal: can we do a usage + ROI checkpoint?

Sam / Nora — great call today, appreciate the clear goals. Per our discussion, I’m summarizing the health readout and the recommended mutual action plan: 

1) Health snapshot (last 90 days) — highlights
- Total tokens: 18.9M (chat 72%, embeddings 18%, rerank/other 10%)
- Median latency (chat): 82ms; p95: 420ms (p95 increased 3.1% week-over-week pre-call)
- KV cache hit-rate: 62% (target 75%)

2) Proposed quick wins (pilot, 2–4 weeks)
- Cache-hot pilot on top 10 prompt families: estimated token reduction 18–26%
- Moderate batching increase for conversational flows during low-traffic windows: estimated token saving 6–9% and improved throughput
- Quantization/variant pairing for 3 non-critical models to reduce inference cost ~12% at ~<1% quality delta

3) Renewal / commercial recommendation
- Option A (Accelerated validation): 3‑month bridge commit + 100k burst credits. We’ll run pilot and measure SLOs; if savings meet threshold (>=20% token reduction), we convert to 12‑month commit at the validated rate.
- Option B (Direct commit): 12‑month commit with tiered discounts tied to multi-month smoothing and committed volume.

Next steps & owners:
- Redwood (Rishi): implement cache-hot pilot and run latency baseline (ETA: 2 weeks)
- Redwood (Olga): draft M&A (mutual action plan) and term sheet; capture pilot KPIs in the doc
- VerdantRun (Sam/Nora): share additional prompt families and confirm finance stakeholders (done)

I attached the mutual action plan doc and the export we reviewed. I’ll follow up with a short pilot kickoff calendar invite.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
